test_title: PYST 14: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 9 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

A new policy for peace and tolerance was formulated by the member nations in the Universal Council meeting yesterday.

options.text: The member nations formulated a new policy for peace and tolerance in the Universal Council meeting yesterday.
The member nations in the Universal Council meeting yesterday were formulated a new policy for peace and tolerance.
The member nations in the Universal Council meeting yesterday were formulating a new policy for peace and tolerance.
A new policy formulated the member nations in the Universal Council meeting yesterday for peace and tolerance

solution:
The correct answer is **"The member nations formulated a new policy for peace and tolerance in the Universal Council meeting yesterday."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ Let's see the correct sentence with active voice:

A new policy for peace and tolerance was formulated by the member nations in the Universal Council meeting yesterday* (active voice)*</s
